      },

        "id": "S2",
        "at": "replace",
        "from": 252,
        "to": 254,

      "FR-6",
      "NFR-2",
      "NFR-3",
      "AC-3",
      "AC-5"
    ],
    "tests": [
      {
        "name": "StoreDelta and ObservedAppState ignore activePageId switches and never switch activePageId when applying deltas",
        "given": "an element change on page-1, a page switch to page-2, and AppStateDelta.applyTo invoked with emptyScene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted()",
        "expect": "switching activePageId produces an empty AppStateDelta and applyTo leaves activePageId on page-2 unchanged with zero TypeScript errors"
      }
    ],
    "checks": [
      "eslint",
      "vitest"
    ]
  }
